name: Awn
author: Erin Carter
description: Three ranks of wheat stalks recede in shallow perspective on a near-black field, each a slender curved stroke topped by an awned seed-head. Invisible gust fronts sweep across as travelling waves of bow-and-spring-back, pouring a thin palette glow into the heads and awns in proportion to flex; between fronts the field settles near-still and near-dark.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often gust fronts arrive to sweep the field.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How deeply stalks bow under a front and how far the spring-back overshoots.

params.label: Stalk spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between stalks in the nearest rank, from dense thicket to sparse stand.

params.label: Head glow
params.effect: How much brightness the seed-heads and awns catch at full flex.
